title: Minichi Inc
description: About Minichi Inc Minichi Inc is a certified woman-owned business with 30 years of experience in the heavy highway industry, primarily focused on bridge construction and rehabilitation. The company has successfully completed over $140 million in construction work to rebuild and repair roads and bridges in Pennsylvania. Their services include bridge construction, guide rails and road safety, and road signs. Minichi Inc aims to provide pride and excellence in their work, serving clients in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania. Company Minichi was the victim of a cyberattack, resulting in the theft of more than 170 GB of confidential data. The stolen data includes blueprints, site and building plans, banking and financial information, employees’ personal data, and other important company information.
